findings.defect: Six selected proposal records collapsed known homonym or polysemy distinctions into one sense.

findings.note: Resolved by the record-level boundary validator and non-blanket evidence producer.

findings.defect: The prior timing proof accepted pre-finalized decision artifacts and did not prove that decision work occurred inside the measured pass.
findings.remediation: Run a producer with the unit input during the timed interval, record its execution binding, and reconstruct decisions from those rows only after stop.
findings.note: Resolved by v5 timing sessions that invoke the producer during each pass and bind its input/output execution.

findings.note: Resolved by the structured audit decision producer and schema.

findings.defect: The canonical shard and downstream counts had to be regenerated after semantic review corrections.
findings.remediation: Regenerate canonical JSONL, inventory, SQLite, metrics, and gate artifacts from the corrected reviewed staging.
